quests.title: Anomaly: Natlan

dialogue.section: Check out the situation at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

dialogue.t: Hmm? Oh, it's you two. Sorry, I didn't notice you there.
It looked like you were lost in thought, staring at that pillar of light caused by the Heavenly Principles' nail...
Yeah, I was. Whatever it is, and whatever it's for, it's in quite the precarious position here...
It's a tricky one, yeah... Natlan's one is right nearby where everyone lives.
I heard you took out Ronova in Snezhnaya? Pretty impressive work.
Thanks, but... we suspect that this whole situation might be Ronova's way of getting her revenge...
We aren't exactly in celebration mode right now. Hard to be proud of what we achieved when we've dragged everyone into this.
Hey, don't say that. If it weren't for Capitano, it would've been my life that Ronova took back then. I didn't like her either.
Ronova, and the Heavenly Principles she represents, have always treated Natlan as a tool to deal with the Abyss and the world's destruction...
...Most of the disasters Natlan suffered in the past were thanks to them.
Whatever might happen in the future, you won't be the ones to blame. It'll be the usual suspects wreaking havoc as always.
You do have a point... Thanks for being so understanding, Mavuika.
All we can do is focus on the here and now. I'll inform the local population, tell them to be on the lookout for any signs of danger.

quests.description: Something strange appears to be happening with the Nail of Retribution all across Teyvat. Go check out what's going on.
